test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is highest quality coal?
solution:
The correct answer is __Anthracite.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Anthracite is the highest quality of hard coal.

 
 
• Anthracite is the most highly metamorphosed form of coal.
 
• It contains around 86% fixed carbon and 14% volatile matter.
 
• Anthracite considered the least plentiful form of coal.
 
 
 
• Coal is considered the most abundantly available fossil fuel.
 
 
• It provides a substantial part of the nation’s energy needs.
 
• Coal is formed due to the compression of plant material over a long period of time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Lignite is low-grade brown coal.

 
 
• Lignite is soft with high moisture content.
 
• The principal lignite reserves are in Neyveli in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• Bituminous coal is the coal that has been buried deep and subjected to increased temperatures.
 
 
• Bituminous coal is the most popular coal in commercial use.
 
 
 
• Decaying plants in swamps produce peat coal.
 
 
• Peat has low carbon and high moisture content and low heating capacity.
